paper: D3: Training-Free AI-Generated Video Detection Using Second-Order Features (Zheng et al., ICCV 2025)
arxiv_id: n/a (CVF Open Access ICCV 2025; code github.com/Zig-HS/D3)
training_set_in_paper: NONE — D3 is training-free (inference only). Baselines (re-implemented for comparison) were trained on real videos from Youku-mPLUG + Pika fakes, following DeMamba (paper Sec 4.1).
encoder_in_paper: XCLIP-B/16 (X-CLIP ViT-B/16, Ni et al. ECCV'22, paper ref [34]) as the frozen per-frame visual encoder; first-order = L2 distance. CLIP-B/16 is the ablation runner-up (~97 on GenVideo, Table 7).
paper_protocol: Extract up to a 2 s segment, sample frames at 8 fps, JPEG; crop 10% of the longer edge then resize to 224x224. Score = std of 2nd-order central-difference of inter-frame L2 distances (Eq.8). Metric reported: AP (real-class); AUROC in supplementary. Hardware RTX 4090. (paper Sec 4.1 'Implementation Details')
synthscope_encoder: X-CLIP-B/16 (microsoft/xclip-base-patch16), as in the paper. SynthScope's D3 gives the same score as the official D3_model on the same frames (max |diff| 0, repro check 2026-10-11).

benchmarks.name: GenVideo (DeMamba GenVideo-Val, Table 1)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator_note: These are the D3 (XCLIP-B/16) AP values from paper Table 1. With CLIP-B/16 (Table 7) GenVideo mAP = 97.00 (L2) / 87.82 (cos).
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: XCLIP-B/16 frozen, 8 fps over <=2 s, JPEG, 10% longer-edge crop, resize 224x224, L2 first-order, std of 2nd-order central diff; AP computed real-class (positive=real, score=+std), max_len=1000 per class (official eval.py).

our_number.note: D3 protocol (--limit 1000: first 1000 clips per class per generator; AP with real as the positive class). SynthScope engine 99.14 AP (AUROC 98.46, balanced acc 96.15 at the refitted calibration; tag d3_genvideo, job 252246). Official D3 code end to end: 97.93 (tag d3_official_genvideo, job 252271): 9 of 10 generators within 0.25 of the paper; WildScrape 92.50 vs 96.49 (282 GIFs whose length decord cannot read start at 0 instead of a random offset). The old 63.93 compared 10,000 reals with as few as 56 fakes and used AP with fake as positive.

benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk: /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/d3_repro/genvideo_val/GenVideo-Val (14 GB; downloaded from ModelScope cccnju/Gen-Video GenVideo-Val.zip). The real source is MSR-VTT.
benchmarks.xclip_weights_downloadable: YES — microsoft/xclip-base-patch16 on HuggingFace (Kinetics-400 trained, NOT gated). Matches paper ref [34]. The gap-closing fix (swap CLIP->XCLIP) is unblocked by available weights.

benchmarks.name: EvalCrafter (Table 2, 14 generators, fake-only)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator_note: D3 (XCLIP-B/16) AP from paper Table 2. CLIP-B/16 EvalCrafter mAP = 97.63 (L2) in Table-7 ablation.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same XCLIP-B/16 protocol as GenVideo. EvalCrafter is fake-only; AP is scored by pairing each generator's fakes against a shared real pool (SynthScope reuses the GenVideo-Val MSR-VTT reals; real_acc=81.33 across all rows).

benchmarks.paper_per_generator_note: Text2Video-Zero (T2VZ) AP=45.11 is a known D3 failure mode (low-quality, semantically-incoherent generation looks 'chaotic'/high-volatility like real). CLIP-B/16 VidProM mAP = 84.79 (Table 7).
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same XCLIP-B/16 protocol. VidProM = Wang & Yang, NeurIPS'24.

our_number.note: Subsample: the first 1000 clips of tar part 1 for the 4 generators on Hugging Face (ModelScope, Pika, Text2Video-Zero, VideoCrafter2); OpenSora and StreamingT2V are not released there. The paper's values for those 4 average 84.95; the official D3 code gives 84.91 (MS 96.30, Pika 98.79, T2VZ 46.36, VC2 98.21; tag d3_official_vidprom, job 252291). SynthScope's engine gives 92.15 (T2VZ 71.28: without the official JPEG frame round-trip D3 ranks these low-quality clips better; tag d3_vidprom, job 252256).

benchmarks.dataset_source: HF: VidProM (Wang & Yang, openreview pYNl76onJL; huggingface VidProM). Needs download.

summary.key_finding: Since 2026-10-11 SynthScope's D3 follows the official preprocessing (16 frames at 8 fps, 8 for clips under 2 s; BGR; 10% crop of the longer side; ImageNet normalization) and is scored with D3's protocol (first 1000 clips per class, AP with real as the positive class). The official D3 code run end to end on the same data (repro/official_evals/d3_official_eval.py) reproduces GenVideo 97.93, EvalCrafter 98.70, VideoPhy 98.84 (8 of 10 generators) and VidProM 84.91 (4 of 6 generators, paper 84.95 on those 4); SynthScope's engine gives 99.14 / 99.30 / 99.45 / 92.15. The remaining engine-vs-official difference is only the official JPEG frame round-trip.
